items.title: Successful stopped executions have one output and count

source.anchor: Algorithm D.2 deterministic stopped-gradient routine; implementation identity needed to use the same routine in D.4
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang; ASTIS explicitly scoped implementation restatement, not a full D.4 or main theorem.

items.statement: For the deterministic stopped gradient interpreter of Algorithm D.2, any two successful finite-fuel executions from the same y and initial x, using the same g,eta,eps, return exactly the same pair (output point, actual gradient-test count), independently of the sufficient fuels.
assumptions: E is a real normed vector space; g:E->E, eta,eps,y and initial state x are arbitrary. Two supplied finite fuels n,m yield successful returned pairs r,s under the same deterministic interpreter. No positivity, contractivity or termination hypothesis.
